mapper.select: SELECT o.*, s.name as service_name, s.price as service_price, s.description as service_description, u.display_name as user_name, u.phone as user_phone, st.short_name as store_name, st.address as store_address FROM order_info o LEFT JOIN service_item s ON o.service_id = s.id LEFT JOIN user_account u ON o.user_id = u.id AND u.account_type = 'user' LEFT JOIN store st ON o.store_id = st.id WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT o.*, s.name as service_name, s.price as service_price, s.description as service_description, u.display_name as user_name, u.phone as user_phone, st.short_name as store_name, st.address as store_address FROM order_info o LEFT JOIN service_item s ON o.service_id = s.id LEFT JOIN user_account u ON o.user_id = u.id AND u.account_type = 'user' LEFT JOIN store st ON o.store_id = st.id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
